# Example: repeated delivery and bridge outage
The peer sends `delivery_id=dlv-pr-42-1` three times. The first inbound write commits one local objective and one ACK; the next two resolve the same dedupe key and replay the ACK without duplicate work. The bridge then becomes unreachable. Outbound delivery is retried with the same id, then dead-lettered after the bound; one outage incident is recorded.
During the outage a local ticket progresses and its report is committed to controller DuckBrain. The local report is not blocked by Crier, and the dead-letter is not treated as peer completion. Recovery re-drives with the same id and verifies the peer result.
